_meta.summary: Higgsfield CLI v0.1.36 has no standalone TTS, music, or SFX models. Audio is bundled into video generation (Kling sound flag, Veo 3.1 native audio, Marketing Studio Video generate_audio flag). For continuous narration we use ElevenLabs as the v1 provider via voiceover-client.ts. When Higgsfield ships standalone Speak/Music/Voice CLI subcommands, swap the provider in voiceover-client.ts without changing routes.

video_models_with_bundled_audio.notes: DTC ads voiceover via Marketing Studio pipeline
Veo 3.1 generates native audio automatically; no flag exposed in CLI params
Seedance 2.0 has bundled audio in web UI but no audio flag exposed in CLI params

frame_pair_animation.notes: Per `higgsfield generate create --help`: 'Media flags: --image, --start-image, --end-image, --video, --audio. Media flags accept a UUID (upload id or job id) or a local file path — paths are auto-uploaded.' This is the smooth A→B transition mechanism.

voice.reason: Higgsfield CLI does not yet expose standalone TTS. ElevenLabs has best-in-class voice quality, free tier (10k chars/mo), instant voice cloning API, and is the industry standard.
voice.swap_point: packages/dashboard/server/lib/higgsfield-audio-client.ts:generateVoiceover() — when Higgsfield ships a Speak CLI model, branch on provider here

music.reason: No music gen in Higgsfield CLI; auto-music sourcing deferred to v2
music.fallback: Hero tier reels can run without music; Kling's bundled ambient audio fills the gap

sfx.reason: No SFX gen in Higgsfield CLI; Kling sound=on bundles ambient SFX per clip

voice_cloning.reason: ElevenLabs has instant cloning from a single sample upload
